definitions.gloss: situation, state of affairs, the way things stand
definitions.explanation: The current state of a contest, conflict, or competition. Often used to describe which side has the advantage.

examples.japanese: {形勢|けいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{形勢|けいせい}⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{撤退|てったい}した→撤退する：25360_tettaisuru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing that the situation was unfavorable, they retreated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧{形勢|けいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The situation changed dramatically in the second half.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {形勢|けいせい}⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧: reversal of the situation, turning the tables
- {形勢|けいせい}⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧: unfavorable situation, being at a disadvantage
- {形勢|けいせい}⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧: favorable situation, having the advantage
- {形勢|けいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to assess the situation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{情勢|じょうせい}→情勢：12739_jousei⟧: situation, state of affairs (broader; used for political/social conditions)
- ⟦{戦況|せんきょう}→戦況：21291_senkyou⟧: war situation, state of the battle
- ⟦{局面|きょくめん}→局面：05777_kyokumen⟧: phase, aspect (of a situation or game)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧ (formation, forming).

cross_references.label: war situation, state of the battle
